articles.title: Mizoram Police arrest Manipur man with heroin worth Rs 2.91 crore
articles.summary: A senior police official said that a special team of the state police conducted random checks at Kualmawi in Keifang, Saitual district, as part of its ongoing enforcement activities on Tuesday night. articles.title: Great Indian Bustard chick killed by fox days after release in Rajasthan; rewilding
articles.summary: JAIPUR: A six-month-old male Great Indian Bustard (GIB) was killed by a fox just four days after being released into the wild at Desert National Park in Rajasthan’s Jaisalmer district on October 14. The bird was part of a government rewilding programme under which 11 captive-bred Great Indian Bustards were to be released into the wild.

articles.title: Indian Railways links Chhattisgarh’s Rowghat to national network for first time since
articles.summary: Indian Railways has connected Rowghat in Chhattisgarh to the national rail network for the first time since Independence. Chief Minister Vishnu Deo Sai flagged off two new passenger services Rowghat-Raipur and Raipur-Kurud as the Tadoki-Rowghat and Abhanpur-Kurud rail sections were inaugurated. Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw also outlined plans to expand connectivity towards Rowghat, Jagdalpur and Visakhapatnam.

articles.title: Farmers Threaten Militant Resistance Against Proposed India-United States Trade Deal
articles.summary: The All India Kisan Sabha has warned the government of militant resistance if it proceeds with a proposed trade deal with the United States. Leaders claim the pact threatens domestic agriculture and dairy farmers while enabling corporate consolidation in rural sectors. The warning highlights growing tensions over agricultural policies and rural livelihoods across the country as negotiations continue.

The German automaker first showcased the model to the world at EICMA in 2025. It has now filed a design patent in the country. A patent does not mean that a company may launch a product soon.

articles.title: Kuki-Zo Forum Demands President Rule And Political Dialogue In Manipur

articles.title: RBI imposes restrictions on Puducherry Co-op Urban Bank, caps withdrawals
articles.summary: The Reserve Bank of India imposed restrictions on Puducherry Co-operative Urban Bank due to financial instability. Customers are limited to withdrawals of Rs 5,000 over the next six months. The bank's recent lack of compliance with supervisory concerns prompted these regulatory actions. Eligible depositors can claim up to Rs 5 lakh through the Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation.

The police seek to investigate further, recover weapons, and uncover the motive behind the incident. The accused were recently apprehended in Kota and transferred to Mumbai for formal arrest. Gunshots were fired at Shroff's vehicle, injuring his driver and a bystander.

articles.title: Karnataka: MLC polls set for tight Congress-NDA contest in four seats
articles.summary: Polling for four Karnataka Legislative Council seats is scheduled, reflecting the sentiments of educated voters in the state. The ruling Congress party and the BJP-JD(S) alliance are closely contesting these elections, with significant implications for their political standings. Three sitting MLCs are seeking re-election, while the BJP has introduced a new candidate in one constituency.
articles.title_hi: कर्नाटक: एमएलसी चुनाव में चार सीटों पर कांग्रेस-एनडीए के बीच कड़ा मुकाबला तय
articles.summary_hi: कर्नाटक विधान परिषद की चार सीटों के लिए मतदान निर्धारित है, जो राज्य में शिक्षित मतदाताओं की भावनाओं को दर्शाता है। सत्तारूढ़ कांग्रेस पार्टी और भाजपा-जद(एस) गठबंधन इन चुनावों में करीबी मुकाबला कर रहे हैं, जिसका उनकी राजनीतिक स्थिति पर महत्वपूर्ण प्रभाव पड़ रहा है। तीन मौजूदा एमएलसी फिर से चुनाव की मांग कर रहे हैं, जबकि भाजपा ने एक निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में एक नया उम्मीदवार पेश किया है।

articles.title: Will China's weaponising of tunnel-boring tech hit India's border infrastructure push

articles.title: Rajasthan govt website data breach reported, up to 70,000 identity records exposed
articles.summary: The Rajasthan Police may have suffered a data breach. A hacker group alleges that it managed to hack into the official Rajasthan Police website, and gain access to sensitive data. articles.title: Two new subterranean fish species discovered in Assam’s Goalpara
articles.summary: The newly identified species are Gitchak nakana, a tiny, transparent and blind loach, and Rakthamichthys anchi, a slender, eel-like fish belonging to the swamp eel family. According to Baruah, Gitchak nakana measures around two centimetres and appears reddish because its transparent body exposes its blood and internal organs. Rakthamichthys anchi, meanwhile, is adapted to life in underground groundwater environments.

articles.summary: The Lakshmana Temple, built entirely of bricks and dating to around the 7th century, is considered one of India’s earliest and best-preserved brick temples. articles.title: Ground below Uttarakhand quietly building energy for a mega earthquake: Study
articles.summary: The fault beneath the Uttarakhand Himalayas is strongly locked and accumulating tectonic strain, with the stored energy equivalent to that released by a magnitude 8. 1 earthquake approximately every 100 years, a new study has found. The research raises concerns about the long-term seismic potential of the central Himalayas, a region that scientists consider part of a major seismic gap.

articles.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi Urges Unity Against National Threats
articles.summary: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has called for national unity and self-reliance to confront three primary challenges he identifies as threats to the nation: terrorism, social discord, and economic instability. In a recent speech, Modi urged citizens to unite against these adversities that he believes undermine the fabric of the country.

articles.title: After 79 years, Railways reaches this remote town for the first time since Independence
articles.summary: Indian Railways has connected Chhattisgarhs Rowghat to the national rail network for the first time since Independence, with the inauguration of the Tadoki-Rowghat railway line. The 17. 5-km stretch completes the 95-km Dalli-Rajhara-Rowghat project. Two new passenger services, Rowghat-Raipur and Raipur-Kurud, were also flagged off, improving regional connectivity and access to industrial and economic opportunities.

articles.title: Rajasthan woman kills 13-year-old twin sons after lover refuses to accept them; arrested
articles.summary: A woman in Rajasthan has been arrested for murdering her 13-year-old twin sons after her lover refused to accept the children from her first marriage, police said on Tuesday night. The bodies of the twins were found in a field in Rajasthan’s Deeg district, with police arresting their mother within six hours of launching the murder investigation.

articles.title: 105 members of US Congress urge FBI to investigate Illinois Hindu Temple shooting plot

Lawmakers expressed concerns over increasing threats targeting Indian and Hindu Americans and sought comprehensive federal responses. They criticized dangerous messaging that fosters racial and religious stereotypes within government communications.

Chandigarh Airport serves the planned city designed by Le Corbusier, the joint capital of Punjab and Haryana. It also draws passengers from Mohali, Panchkula and the hill towns of Himachal Pradesh.
articles.title_hi: चंडीगढ़ हवाई अड्डा गाइड: पंजाब और हरियाणा का प्रवेश द्वार

articles.title: Rajasthan temperatures fall below 20°C in 10 cities: New weather system to become active
articles.summary: Follow Bhaskar English for Rajasthan weather updates, rain, hail, and new Western Disturbance warnings. Winds coming from the Arabian Sea brought thunderstorms, rain and hail to southern districts of Rajasthan on Tuesday. The Meteorological Department has forecast dry weather across the state for the next 3 days, while a new western disturbance is likely to become active from 24 October.

articles.title: India seeks global vigilance regarding transfer of sensitive weapons technology

articles.title: HP Guv Kavinder releases books on Dogri theatre
articles.summary: JAMMU, Oct 20: The Governor of Himachal Pradesh, Kavinder Gupta today released three books on Dogri theatre authored, adapted and translated by noted theatre director and playwright Dr Sudhir Mahajan. The three books-Trai Dogri Natak, Char Bal Natak and a collection of translated and adapted plays-bring together nine plays covering a wide range of social, historical, philosophical and contemporary themes.

articles.title: Delhi Police transfers second case against jailed party leaders to Crime Branch
articles.summary: Delhi Police transferred a second case involving jailed Cockroach Janta Party co-convenors Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka to the Crime Branch on Tuesday.
